description: Refactor hello.py to define a function greet(name='world') that returns the string 'hello <name>' (e.g. greet() -> 'hello world', greet('ada') -> 'hello ada'), and make the __main__ block print greet(). Preserve existing behavior: running 'python hello.py' must still print exactly 'hello world'. Add pytest unit tests in test_hello.py for greet() covering both the default and a custom name, keeping the existing script-output test passing.
